lines.text: Your brain thinks at four hundred words a minute. Your fingers? About forty.
So every Slack reply becomes a typing marathon.
And autocorrect still sends, "Let's shop it," to your CEO.
Just talk. Your words appear right at your cursor, in whatever app you're in. Slack, email, Jira, docs.
Your keyboard finally gets a vacation.
Lynk. You talk, it types. Start free at Lynk dot A I.

note: Lynkk is spelled 'Lynk' and lynkk.ai as 'Lynk dot A I' in the voice lines only, so the voice says it right.
